svg.title: Toy model, 400 steps on a similar pair: DPO sends the chosen probability to 0 and the harmful answer to 0.999; DPO plus NLL keeps the chosen at 0.92; IPO stops at a gap of 1 with the chosen at 0.22 and the harmful answer at 0.40
